Thanks for your feedback, I will try to change the grammar.
The page was already with anomalous properties when the circus guys found it, so they think it was a great idea to make an attraction involving the page.
That's why is there other pages, one will show the saddest moment, another one will show the most terrific moment, the pages can't show future events, and the page will be different if you got another moment more important than the last one that the page shows before.
More details about this SCP will be shown in the draft.

item.title: Re: Pages that show a comic of your life (Seeking for Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
I don't want to come off as picky but could you change the grammar of your central narrative. I'm finding it hard to understand what's causing what.

that shows the happiest moment of your life, a circus has an attraction that says "revive the happiest moment of your life" the people that go to the attraction always get out with great enthusiasm

Who's results was this? Was it just like this when they found it or did it transform?

I like the idea, but it's not grabbing my attention yet. The fact that the pages transform to past events gives off a nice nostalgic feeling but I would like it if you added in elements of discomfort or hurt too. Plus, do the pages only show only the past events or could they show current or future events too?

Forum critique should be relatively in-depth.

Try to make sure you give enough criticism that an author can tell the quality of their entire concept/draft. What did you like or dislike about the concept? What changes would you suggest? Do you personally see this as something successful on the site? Please try to endeavour in writing a more detailed analysis when dropping critique in the future, as it would be of a better benefit to the author.

item.title: Pages that show a comic of your life (Seeking for Greenlight)
item.content:encoded:
Pages that show differents moments of your life if you hold it.

I moved and trimmed your thread summary, since it was taking up extra space in the main forum screen. Try to keep thread descriptions (the text in the little box under the thread title) and titles short so you don't crowd out other authors in the forum listing. ~Zyn

Seeking Greenlights: Yes

Page Type: SCP Article.

Genre: Not decided yet.

Page Layout: I will use a normal type of layout (I don't know too much how to edit the layout), but I will separate the many types of pages of the SCP.

Elevator Pitch:

  • Blanks-torn pages encounter all over the world, if someone grabs a page it will show a comic of different moments in your life depending on which page you grab.
  • The pages show moments with relations with emotions, for example, one page will show the happiest moment in your life, another one will show the angriest moment, etc.
  • The style of drawing of the comic will depend on the own style and knowledge of the person holding the page.
+ show block
– hide block

Central Narrative: The pages are spread all over the world and each page will show a different moment if all the pages are found it will be possible for the pages to show a short version of your life in form of a comic.

The first page the foundation encounters was the page that shows the happiest moment of your life, a circus has an attraction that says "revive the happiest moment of your life" the people that go to the attraction always get out with great enthusiasm, the foundation decided to investigate thinking it was any form of drug or special ability of an anomalous human, but it was a simple page that shows a comic when it is holding it after it was discovered another page in another country this time the page shows the hungriest moment after this many others pages are being found, but the foundation thinks that are many more pages hiding around the world.

The pages can be used to know more things about certain SCP.

The origins are not certain, but the foundation wants to find all the pages as quickly as possible.

Hook/Attention-Grabber: The principal theme of this SCP is the discovery of the most important moments in your life and how this can affect your way to see the world and see you, and how knowing or remember again these moments can affect you.

Additional Notes: I have not to make a draft yet, but the article will have two images taken from me I get greenlighted.


As a courtesy to our readers on mobile devices, please collapse long posts and properly space your paragraphs. ~Zyn
